dartdoc.description: Configuration options for the dartdoc API documentation generator.

categories.description: A map from category names to category definitions.

markdown.description: Path to a markdown file to be rendered on the category page.

displayName.description: The alternative name to use in the rendered HTML instead of the map key.

categoryOrder.description: An ordered list of categories to prioritize in the sidebar layout.

examplePathPrefix.description: Prefix path for locating files referenced via @example tags.

includeExternal.description: Additional external Dart files to include in the generation process.

nodoc.description: File patterns or library names that should be excluded from documentation.

showUndocumentedCategories.description: Whether categories without explicit matching tags should be rendered.

linkToSource.description: Configuration to link symbols back to their source repository hosts.

ignore.description: Issues or warnings to completely suppress during validation.

warnings.description: Validation issues to treat as warnings.

errors.description: Validation issues to treat as hard build errors.

tools.description: Custom commands or compilation macros invoked via @tool directives.
